description: This file defines an internal class AllStreamNamespacesPredicate implementing the IChannelNamespacePredicate interface, used for matching stream namespaces in Orleans.BroadcastChannel, specifically matching all namespaces.

classes.name: AllStreamNamespacesPredicate
classes.description: An internal class that matches all stream namespaces by returning true for any input string.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property returning '*' as the matching pattern for stream namespaces.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Method that returns true for any given streamNamespace, indicating it matches all.
